title: The code is the payment
scenario: Someone claiming to be a relative’s attorney says court fees must be paid immediately but their office cannot take cards after hours. They ask you to buy gift cards and send photos of the codes.

answers.A: Stop and verify the relative and the attorney independently; do not send gift-card codes as payment.
answers.B: Call the law office using a number you find independently and ask whether any fee is due.
answers.C: Buy the cards but keep the codes until you reach the relative directly.

explanation: Gift-card codes function like cash once shared. The unusual payment method is itself a strong warning signal.
proTip: If the “payment” is a code, treat it like cash leaving your hand.
